purpose: Add public-YouTube-video source support across Stage A ingest, Stage B re-fetch, schema, GitHub Actions workflows, and dashboard UI
decisions: Introduce explicit source kind "youtube" in schemas/stage_a_request.schema.json and ingest dispatch for clarity and consistency across schema, refetch, wizard, and docs.

Layered runner strategy for yt-dlp: (1) Run latest yt-dlp binary with player client fallback list (e.g. android, ios, web); (2) Optional repo secret YOUTUBE_COOKIES written to secure temp file with 0600 permissions; (3) Optional proxy YOUTUBE_PROXY_URL; (4) Actionable error messages for bot-check, age-restriction, members-only, private, removed, livestreams; (5) Merge video+audio via ffmpeg capped at 1080p by default (configurable via CLIPFORGE_YT_MAX_HEIGHT); (6) Enforce MAX_VIDEO_BYTES (12 GiB) and free disk space check.
